## Network Security  
### Perimeter Security  
**Firewall:**
- Stateful inspection firewall
- Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs
- Egress: Restricted outbound (whitelist-based)
- Rules logged and monitored  
**DDoS Protection:**
- AWS Shield (managed DDoS protection)
- Rate limiting on APIs
- Anomalous traffic detection
- Traffic rerouting if DDoS detected  
**Intrusion Detection/Prevention:**
- Network-based IDS (Snort-like rules)
- Host-based IDS on critical systems
- Automated response (block malicious IPs)

raw_entities.description: A formal policy governing the security of the bank's network infrastructure, specifically focusing on perimeter security, firewall configurations, and threat mitigation.

raw_entities.name: Stateful Inspection Firewall Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates the use of a stateful inspection firewall to manage network traffic flow.

raw_entities.name: Public API Ingress Restriction
raw_entities.description: Restricts incoming network traffic for public APIs to Port 443 (HTTPS) only.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

raw_entities.name: Whitelist-Based Egress Control
raw_entities.description: Requires that outbound network traffic be restricted based on a predefined whitelist.

raw_entities.name: Firewall Rule Logging and Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Requires that all firewall rules are logged and continuously monitored for security purposes.

raw_entities.name: DDoS Protection Implementation
raw_entities.description: Mandates the implementation of managed DDoS protection and traffic management to prevent service disruption.

raw_entities.name: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires the deployment of both network-based and host-based intrusion detection systems with automated response capabilities.

raw_entities.name: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS)
raw_entities.description: The risk of service unavailability caused by anomalous traffic volumes or targeted DDoS attacks.

raw_entities.name: Network Intrusion
raw_entities.description: The risk of malicious actors gaining unauthorized access to the network or critical systems.

raw_entities.name: Stateful Inspection Firewall
raw_entities.description: A technical control used to monitor the state of active connections to determine which network packets to allow through.

raw_entities.name: AWS Shield
raw_entities.description: A managed DDoS protection service used to safeguard the bank's network perimeter.

raw_entities.name: API Rate Limiting
raw_entities.description: A mechanism to limit the number of requests to APIs to prevent abuse and DDoS attacks.

raw_entities.name: Network-based IDS
raw_entities.description: A system that monitors network traffic for malicious activity using Snort-like rules.

raw_entities.name: Host-based IDS
raw_entities.description: A security system installed on critical servers to detect internal intrusions or unauthorized changes.

raw_entities.name: Automated IP Blocking
raw_entities.description: An automated response mechanism that blocks malicious IP addresses upon detection of an intrusion.
